answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 14559 Country: United Arab Emirates Title: I have a credit card and I pay outstanding amount before incurring any interest by bank. Bank offers discount of 3% on every transaction done through Credit card. For example if I have a transaction of AED 100 on credit card then I have to pay AED 97 before due date. Please advise whether discount of AED 3 offered by Bank is Hallal? Question: I have a credit card and I pay outstanding amount before incurring any interest by bank. Bank offers discount of 3% on every transaction done through Credit card. For example if I have a transaction of AED 100 on credit card then I have to pay AED 97 before due date. Please advise whether discount of AED 3 offered by Bank is Hallal? Answer ID: 14559 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1123/954=L/1430) The discount of 3 AED given by the bank is interest; it is not lawful for you to use. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
